en.text: The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.

zhSimplified.text: 诸天述说 神的荣耀； 穹苍传扬他的手段。

zhTraditional.text: 諸天述說上帝的榮耀； 穹蒼傳揚他的手段。

en.text: Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge.

zhSimplified.text: 这日到那日发出言语； 这夜到那夜传出知识。

zhTraditional.text: 這日到那日發出言語； 這夜到那夜傳出知識。

en.text: There is no speech nor language where their voice is not heard.

zhSimplified.text: 无言无语， 也无声音可听。

zhTraditional.text: 無言無語， 也無聲音可聽。

en.text: Their voice has gone out through all the earth, their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,

zhSimplified.text: 它的量带通遍天下， 它的言语传到地极。 神在其间为太阳安设帐幕；

zhTraditional.text: 它的量帶通遍天下， 它的言語傳到地極。 上帝在其間為太陽安設帳幕；

en.text: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room, like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.

zhSimplified.text: 太阳如同新郎出洞房， 又如勇士欢然奔路。

zhTraditional.text: 太陽如同新郎出洞房， 又如勇士歡然奔路。

en.text: His going out is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends. There is nothing hidden from its heat.

zhSimplified.text: 它从天这边出来，绕到天那边， 没有一物被隐藏不得它的热气。

zhTraditional.text: 它從天這邊出來，繞到天那邊， 沒有一物被隱藏不得它的熱氣。

en.text: The LORD’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. The LORD’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华的律法全备，能苏醒人心； 耶和华的法度确定，能使愚人有智慧。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華的律法全備，能甦醒人心； 耶和華的法度確定，能使愚人有智慧。

en.text: The LORD’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. The LORD’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华的训词正直，能快活人的心； 耶和华的命令清洁，能明亮人的眼目。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華的訓詞正直，能快活人的心； 耶和華的命令清潔，能明亮人的眼目。

en.text: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring forever. The LORD’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华的道理洁净，存到永远； 耶和华的典章真实，全然公义—

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華的道理潔淨，存到永遠； 耶和華的典章真實，全然公義－

en.text: They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.

zhSimplified.text: 都比金子可羡慕，且比极多的精金可羡慕； 比蜜甘甜，且比蜂房下滴的蜜甘甜。

zhTraditional.text: 都比金子可羨慕，且比極多的精金可羨慕； 比蜜甘甜，且比蜂房下滴的蜜甘甜。

en.text: Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward.

zhSimplified.text: 况且你的仆人因此受警戒， 守着这些便有大赏。

zhTraditional.text: 況且你的僕人因此受警戒， 守着這些便有大賞。

en.text: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.

zhSimplified.text: 谁能知道自己的错失呢？ 愿你赦免我隐而未现的过错。

zhTraditional.text: 誰能知道自己的錯失呢？ 願你赦免我隱而未現的過錯。

en.text: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.

zhSimplified.text: 求你拦阻仆人不犯任意妄为的罪， 不容这罪辖制我， 我便完全，免犯大罪。

zhTraditional.text: 求你攔阻僕人不犯任意妄為的罪， 不容這罪轄制我， 我便完全，免犯大罪。

en.text: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, LORD, my rock, and my redeemer.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华—我的磐石，我的救赎主啊， 愿我口中的言语、心里的意念在你面前蒙悦纳。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華－我的磐石，我的救贖主啊， 願我口中的言語、心裏的意念在你面前蒙悅納。
